checks.stdout:
Usage: robot-control-hil --interface can0|none --device /dev/tty... --duration-ms MS (--zero-soak|--zero-only|--single-left|--single-right|--right-throttle|--observe-input|--zero-x1-recovery|--zero-sbus-recovery|--zero-uart-recovery|--restore-zero-baseline|--single-left-negative|--single-right-negative|--dual-positive|--dual-negative|--turn-left|--turn-right|--differential-left|--differential-right)
Optional for control/restore: --zero-feedback-tenths-rpm 0..20 (default20); standstill only; moving direction/target bounds unchanged.
Binding: --right-sign -1|1 (legacy default1); required explicitly for physical motion on can0.
RK3588 vehicle-forward binding: left+1/right-1; raw CAN evidence is retained.
Motion: --motion-window-ms 3000..8000 for legacy positive single-wheel modes; G3 modes require3000.
Default3000; cutoff50ms before limit. G3 differential-left/right means positive left<right/left>right.
Differential trials allow positive equal-wheel approach; require two fresh unequal-target/directional feedback samples.
Zero-soak: requires ROBOT_CONTROL_HIL_TRACE_FD nonblocking pipe; duration 2000..3600000ms.
MS: 2000..20000 for zero-only; 2000..120000 for zero-uart-recovery; 2000..60000 for other bounded trials.
